HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we inform you that the Board of Directors of Takyon Networks ....
MORE: Pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we inform you that the Board of Directors of Takyon Networks Limited at its meeting held today, Saturday, November 14, 2026, has considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the half-year ended September 30, 2026 along with the Independent Auditor Limited Review Reports thereon. The Board Meeting commenced at 04:00 PM IST and concluded at 04:55 PM IST. Please find enclosed the outcome along with the financial results and limited review reports.
